name: Maria Rodriguez
bio:
Maria Rodriguez's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly after a career in a local diner. Her passion for food and a chance encounter with a race team passing through town sparked a new ambition. Recognizing the need for quality, reliable catering at the track, Maria leveraged her experience to establish herself as a catering manager.

Initially focusing on local races, Maria quickly developed a reputation for her dedication and ability to handle the demands of a fast-paced environment. Her approach prioritizes fresh ingredients and adaptable menus, tailored to the specific needs of each team. Maria is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to providing exceptional service. 

What sets Maria apart is her knack for creating a sense of community through food. She believes that shared meals can foster camaraderie and boost morale, making her an invaluable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.description: Maria is of average height with a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Insists on using locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Has a knack for remembering everyone's favorite dish.
